# CSV quoting study

[Runnable CSV probe](../../prototypes/export_csv_probe.py) round-trips item names containing commas through Python's CSV writer and reader. The probe is the accepted study source.

Run `python prototypes/export_csv_probe.py` from the project root. Successful execution exits with no output after confirming that the comma in Tea, green stays inside one field.
files.prototypes/export_csv_probe.py:
import csv, io
stream=io.StringIO()
csv.writer(stream).writerow(["Tea, green", "Mug"] )
assert next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(stream.getvalue())))==["Tea, green", "Mug"]
